name: SEO Checker
seoTitle: Free SEO Checker — Instant AI Website SEO Analysis
metaDescription: Check your website's SEO for free. Our AI SEO checker analyses titles, meta descriptions, headings, structured data, sitemaps and more in seconds.
intro: If your website isn't ranking, the reason is usually a handful of fixable on-page SEO issues — not a mystery algorithm change. Our free SEO checker scans your homepage against the same fundamentals Google uses to understand and rank pages, and tells you exactly what's missing.
whatWeCheck: Title tag presence and optimal length (30-60 characters)
Meta description presence and optimal length (50-160 characters)
Heading structure — single H1, no skipped levels
Open Graph and Twitter Card tags for social sharing
Structured data — schema.org, LocalBusiness, FAQ, breadcrumbs
Duplicate titles and broken internal links

faq.question: Why isn't my website showing up on Google?
faq.answer: The most common causes are missing or poor title tags, no meta description, missing structured data, or a missing sitemap.xml — all of which our SEO checker detects instantly, along with exactly how to fix each one.

faq.question: Does this SEO checker look at more than my homepage?
faq.answer: The free scan analyses your homepage in depth, which is where most SEO fundamentals live (title, meta description, structured data, robots.txt, sitemap). For a full site crawl and deeper technical SEO work, book a free consultation.

faq.question: What's the difference between this and tools like SEMrush or Ahrefs?
faq.answer: SEMrush and Ahrefs are built for keyword research and backlink analysis at scale. Our SEO checker is built specifically for small business owners who want a fast, plain-English answer to "what's wrong with my website" — free, in 30 seconds, with no learning curve.
